-- Phase 2: bodies filled in. Signatures and contracts are unchanged from Phase 1.
-- log_line uses only io. It declares no fs, so it cannot write a log file.

format_line(level: str, message: str) -> str =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  post out.char_count() == level.char_count() + message.char_count() + 3
  ex format_line("INFO", "started") == "[INFO] started"
  "[\(level)] \(message)"

log_line(level: str, message: str) uses io =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  ex log_line("INFO", "started")
  io.print(format_line(level, message))
